test_case.test_name: AMD in-band UMC OD-ECC correctable ACA and multi-array accounting
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved OD-ECC correctable injection at the mapped address produces attributable ACA fields and an explained zero-to-nonzero UMC counter transition.
required_package: Multi-array delta/quiet-window oracle and GPU recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records GPU/driver/log/counter baseline, verifies ras_enable and zero UMC count, validates address mapping, executes the exact command once, captures tool output, post-counter and complete timestamped ACA lines, explains any delta above one with array evidence, confirms no uncorrectable escalation, then restores driver state and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: The intended UMC reports a source-compliant correctable ACA signature; counter changes from zero to an approved nonzero multi-array delta, no fatal/deferred storm occurs, and GPU/driver health remains good.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires target/address/tool identity, zero baseline, one injection, complete decoded ACA evidence, explained counter delta and healthy quiet window. Wrong target/address, unexplained count, uncorrectable severity or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Approved correctable injection on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Do not inject until address and expected array fanout are mapped.
One injection only; no automatic retry/reset/reboot.
expected_evidence: Zero baseline and single injection transcript
No-escalation quiet window and final health
test_case.recovery: On wrong address, unexpected severity, storm or hang, preserve evidence and use approved reset/rebind/reboot/OOB recovery only; never reinject automatically and restore ras_enable/module state.
